A peptide serum is `a lightweight skincare treatment that uses tiny chains of amino acids to help your skin look firmer and smoother`.[[1]](https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbes-personal-shopper/2026/08/06/best-peptide-serums/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:15474320564230156004,catalogid:15366446604106546830,gpcid:42175154390984629,mid:576462746445076156&ibp=oshop)

### What Peptides Do

- **Boost Collagen:** They signal your skin cells to make more collagen and elastin, which reduces fine lines.[[1]](https://www.colorescience.com/blogs/blog/what-is-peptide-serum)
- **Strengthen Skin:** They help repair and protect your natural moisture barrier.[[1]](https://www.colorescience.com/blogs/blog/what-is-peptide-serum)
- **Hydrate:** Many formulas combine peptides with hyaluronic acid to plump dry skin.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:15474320564230156004,catalogid:15366446604106546830,gpcid:42175154390984629,mid:576462746445076156&ibp=oshop)
